method.runner: qa/card-runner.html loads every @dsCard at its declared viewport in an iframe, waits 3.5s (kits 5s), measures documentElement/body scrollWidth/scrollHeight, broken , empty root, interactive elements past right edge.
method.user: User DOM smoke of 94 published iframes: 0 empty bodies, 0 broken images, 12 horizontal overflows.
method.limits: Structural smoke only — not a per-card visual approval. Console errors inside iframes were not captured by the runner.
